head: working-tree
subject: MQTT $SYS store and outbound packet metrics
change: Broker system statistics now publish $SYS/broker/messages/stored and its $SYS/broker/store/messages/count alias for the durable queued-message gauge, $SYS/broker/store/messages/bytes for queued payload bytes, and $SYS/broker/packet/out/count and $SYS/broker/packet/out/bytes aliases of the existing outbound MQTT control-packet counters. The periodic retained snapshot publishes them through the normal $SYS routing and ACL path.

tests.unit: src/mqtt/broker.zig checks every new topic string. src/mqtt/broker_tests.zig extends the coherent retained statistics test to 14 traffic metrics and verifies the empty durable store, the packet/out aliases matching the sent control-packet count, and positive outbound packet bytes.

focused_gate.command: zig build test-lib -Dtest-filter='coherent retained system statistics' -Dtest-filter='SYS version and client aliases' --summary all

notes: messages/stored maps to netz's durable session queued-message gauge rather than Mosquitto's full database store, and store/messages/bytes counts queued payload bytes. packet/out/count and packet/out/bytes alias netz's complete outbound MQTT control-packet counters, which is the packet-level reading Mosquitto exposes under those topics. $SYS/broker/heap/* remains unavailable because the library broker does not own an accounting allocator; the example process can supply one separately.
